requirements.intent: Analyze existing AGENTS Procedure issue-run records and toolInvocations arrays to identify observed tools and invocation syntax. Define a machine-readable way to extract integrations whose operations create, mutate, or delete data; distinguish these from reads and conditional commands. The extracted create, mutate, and delete operations must be mandatory entries in the change list, with their targets and evidence recorded.
